text.zh: 1.The screw and barrel are made of 38CrMoAlA, the screw is nitrided, and the nitrided layer is thickly plated.
text.en: 1.The screw and barrel are made of 38CrMoAlA, the screw is nitrided, and the nitrided layer is thickly plated.

text.zh: 2.The main motor adopts frequency conversion governor to realize stepless speed regulation.

text.zh: 3.The gear is made of special alloy hard tooth surface, and after normalizing,quenching heat treatment,and finally through the tooth surface grinding treatment,with long service life,shock absorption,wear resistance,low noise characteristics.
text.en: 3.The gear is made of special alloy hard tooth surface, and after normalizing,quenching heat treatment,and finally through the tooth surface grinding treatment,with long service life,shock absorption,wear resistance,low noise characteristics.

text.zh: 4.The gears and bearings are precision ground and hardened to ensure smooth and quiet operation.

text.zh: 5.The gearbox is made of alloy cast steel, and the contact surface of the upper and lower boxes is finely ground.

text.zh: Dongguan Yaoshun® Technology Co., Ltd. - Empowering Innovation and Precision Extrusion Solutions
text.en: Dongguan Yaoshun® Technology Co., Ltd. - Empowering Innovation and Precision Extrusion Solutions

text.zh: Established in 2012, Dongguan Yaoshun® Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer specializing in the production of high-quality extrusion equipment and a wide range of extruded products. With our founder's engineering background and over 20 years of experience in foreign trade, production, and research and development within the industry, we are proud to deliver exceptional solutions to meet diverse customer needs.

text.zh: Engineering Expertise: Founded by an experienced engineer, our company possesses extensive technical knowledge and insights. This expertise allows us to provide innovative and efficient solutions in extrusion technology.

text.zh: Manufacturing Excellence: We excel in the production of various extrusion machinery, including PP, PE, ABS, POM thick plate machines, various types of pipes, profiles, extrusion equipment, automatic pipe cutting machines, traction machines, silicone machines, as well as TPU, PLA, ABS, PC, PE, and PP engineering plastic products. Our state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities and stringent quality control processes ensure the delivery of premium-grade products.

This extensive range enables us to cater to diverse industries and applications.
